key_points: Multiple senior PPG executives (CEO, CFO, operations chief, HR chief) reported recent purchases of PPG stock-linked units.
All transactions occurred at a price of $122.56 per share, consistent with prevailing market levels.
The purchases represent modest volume and are routine compensation or deferred stock unit acquisitions.
No accompanying news about earnings, guidance, regulatory issues, M&A, or product launches.
Insider buying alone typically has limited short‑term price impact, leading to a neutral outlook.
